description: Retrieve an exclusion with agency explanation, named restriction references, source evidence, explicit source-age warnings and supported business links.

generation.description: Retained snapshot UUID; omit for the current snapshot.

id.description: Stable exclusion record ID returned by search_exclusions or check_exclusions.

name: exclusion_context

freshness.description: Fresh, stale, unknown or unavailable, with age and the 24-hour warning policy.

observed_at.description: Observation time does not replace the official source timestamp.

status.description: Present as unavailable when no SAM coverage exists in this generation.

JsonObject.description: Source-specific JSON map. The envelope is stable; map keys vary by official source.

evaluated_at.description: UTC time when age was evaluated; source and observation dates are unchanged.

max_age_seconds.description: Explicit warning threshold for this daily snapshot. Not a scheduler promise.

source_age_seconds.description: Age of the official source timestamp, never the import or enrichment timestamp.

warning.description: User-facing warning, or null when within the warning threshold.

business_context.description: Supported vendor and award links, with match basis.

title: Read exclusion evidence
